name: claim-match
description: Second-generation claim matching: whether a sentence of a later article that cites a review restates one of the review's claims and cites the review for it. Candidates come from BM25 retrieval over the later article's sentences that cite the review; the judge confirms each candidate with an exact quote and explicit abstention.
unit: a pair of an original claim (an S1 locus) and one candidate sentence of a citing article

pair.population: BM25 candidates of the sampled second-generation citing sentences

evidencePolicy.evidence: the original claim sentence, the review's title, the candidate sentence with the review's marker, and the candidate's section

retrieval.receipt: every candidate list keeps its retrieval receipt

repair.scope: items without a valid output after the first call

requiredModel.served: pinned per analysis by the follow-up protocol (model.served)

notes: No validation set measures this instrument's precision; its matches are model measurements.
Draft: status deferred until the follow-up protocol is frozen; the validator digest is pinned then.
